# Setup

Load libraries:

```{r load-libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
```

Load in results from Extinct and Extant simulations:

```{r load-results}
D1_initials <- readRDS("Outputs/D1/Extinct/initials.rds")
D2_initials <- readRDS("Outputs/D2/Extinct/initials.rds")
D3_initials <- readRDS("Outputs/D3/Extinct/initials.rds")
D4_initials <- readRDS("Outputs/D4/Extinct/initials.rds")

D1_thresholds <- readRDS("Outputs/D1/Extinct/thresholds.rds") %>%
  mutate(threshold = if_else(threshold > 1e9, NA, threshold))
D2_thresholds <- readRDS("Outputs/D2/Extinct/thresholds.rds") %>%
  mutate(threshold = if_else(threshold > 1e9, NA, threshold))
D3_thresholds <- readRDS("Outputs/D3/Extinct/thresholds.rds") %>%
  mutate(threshold = if_else(threshold > 1e9, NA, threshold))
D4_thresholds <- readRDS("Outputs/D4/Extinct/thresholds.rds") %>%
  mutate(threshold = if_else(threshold > 1e9, NA, threshold))

D1_extinct <- left_join(D1_initials, D1_thresholds, by = "model")
D2_extinct <- left_join(D2_initials, D2_thresholds, by = "model")
D3_extinct <- left_join(D3_initials, D3_thresholds, by = "model")
D4_extinct <- left_join(D4_initials, D4_thresholds, by = "model")
```

# Extinct Comparison

Compare D1 with D2, D3, and D4:

```{r extinct-comparison}
#| fig-dpi: 600
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 3

D2_joined <- left_join(
  D1_extinct,
  D2_extinct,
  by = "model",
  suffix = c("_D1", "_D2")
)

D3_joined <- left_join(
  D1_extinct,
  D3_extinct,
  by = "model",
  suffix = c("_D1", "_D3")
)

D4_joined <- left_join(
  D1_extinct,
  D4_extinct,
  by = "model",
  suffix = c("_D1", "_D4")
)

threshold_range <- range(
  D1_extinct$threshold,
  D2_extinct$threshold,
  D3_extinct$threshold,
  D4_extinct$threshold,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

D1_plot <- ggplot(D1_extinct) +
  geom_point(aes(x = power, y = threshold)) +
  labs(
    x = "Initial Power at Extinction",
    y = "Time to Achieve 80% Power",
    title = "D1 (Matched)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = threshold_range)

D2_plot <- ggplot(D2_joined) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = power_D1, y = threshold_D1, xend = power_D2, yend = threshold_D2), colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_point(aes(x = power_D1, y = threshold_D1), colour = "grey90", size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(x = power_D2, y = threshold_D2)) +
  labs(
    x = "Initial Power at Extinction",
    y = "Time to Achieve 80% Power",
    title = "D2 (Uncertains Continue)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = threshold_range)

D3_plot <- ggplot(D3_joined) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = power_D1, y = threshold_D1, xend = power_D3, yend = threshold_D3), colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_point(aes(x = power_D1, y = threshold_D1), colour = "grey90", size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(x = power_D3, y = threshold_D3)) +
  labs(
    x = "Initial Power at Extinction",
    y = "Time to Achieve 80% Power",
    title = "D3 (Inverted)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = threshold_range)

D4_plot <- ggplot(D4_joined) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = power_D1, y = threshold_D1, xend = power_D4, yend = threshold_D4), colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_point(aes(x = power_D1, y = threshold_D1), colour = "grey90", size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(x = power_D4, y = threshold_D4)) +
  labs(
    x = "Initial Power at Extinction",
    y = "Time to Achieve 80% Power",
    title = "D4 (Uncertains Increase)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = threshold_range)

ggarrange(D1_plot, D2_plot, D3_plot, D4_plot, ncol = 4)
```
